1.web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
1.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.

2.web: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
2.asv: Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his host.

3.web: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
3.asv: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.

4.web: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, You waters that are above the heavens.
4.asv: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.

5.web: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, For he commanded, and they were created.
5.asv: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he commanded, and they were created.

6.web: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
6.asv: He hath also established them for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass away.

7.web: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths!
7.asv: Praise Jehovah from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;

8.web: Lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
8.asv: Fire and hail, snow and vapor; Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;

9.web: mountains and all hills; fruit trees and all cedars;
9.asv: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;

10.web: wild animals and all livestock; small creatures and flying birds;
10.asv: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying birds;

11.web: kings of the earth and all peoples; princes and all judges of the earth;
11.asv: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;

12.web: both young men and maidens; old men and children:
12.asv: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children:

13.web: let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
13.asv: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

14.web: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!
14.asv: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.
